names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 20 Απριλίου, «Άγιος Γαβριήλ ο Μάρτυρας», with the rank word left off; the life page heads him «Αγιος Γαβριηλ ο Μαρτυρας (1684 - 1690)». The day's line gives him no epithet; the city in the English form here is the one the page names as the place of his martyrdom and of his relics.

Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 20 апреля ст. ст., name page 447, «Гавриил Белостокский, Слуцкий, младенец, мч.», with the grade and the word младенец left off; the line itself gives «Гавриила Белостокского» with the second surname omitted. Measured against the gate’s own key function before it was written: 'белостокскии гавриил слуцкии' has no other holder.

birth.note: saint.gr: «γεννήθηκε το έτος 1684 μ.Χ. στο χωριό Ζβιέρκιυ», and the page heads him «(1684 - 1690)».

death.note: saint.gr: «Όταν ο Άγιος ήταν σε ηλικία 6 ετών, απήχθηκε και οδηγήθηκε στην πόλη Μπιαλιστόκ, όπου και μαρτύρησε, το έτος 1690».

feast.note: His life page heads «Дни памяти: 20 апреля , 9 мая , 8 июня , 8 июня (Белорус.)». One row per church is the schema, so the other three days are recorded here and he does not render on them; none of those three day pages was read.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 20 апреля ст. ст. — «Мч. младенца Гавриила Белостокского (1690).»
source.note: The name page is 447 and the life page life6516. The two years the page gives, 22 марта 1684 and 1690, are the two this folder already carried off saint.gr. TWO THINGS REFUSED AND REPORTED, not resolved: the Russian account, unlike the Greek one this folder was written from, names the child’s killers as Jews and presents his death as a ritual murder — the blood-libel accusation, which has no historical standing — and the day page’s two hymns under his name rest the charge in liturgical verse. The accusation is not repeated in the life and NEITHER HYMN WAS COPIED. That is a reader’s refusal and an author question, not a ruling.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 20ής Απριλίου — «Άγιος Γαβριήλ ο Μάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page names the village Zvierki, south of Białystok in the district of Zabłudów, his age of six at his abduction, the year 1690 of his death, the opening of his tomb in the eighteenth century and the incorrupt relic found there, its keeping at Białystok until the Second World War, its removal then to Russia, to the church of the Protection of the Mother of God at Grodno, and its translation back to Białystok on 21 September 1992 with the blessing of the Russian metropolitan Philaret. It names no judge and no manner of death, calling his killers only «τους εχθρούς της Εκκλησίας», the enemies of the Church, in the setting of the persecutions and discriminations against the Orthodox Church by the Uniates in Poland. It prints no hymn. The corpus keeps many saints named Gabriel; none of them is a child of this date or this country.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
